Not a perfect game, some minor bugs from a lack of polish maybe... but if are looking for an action game based on WH 40k, I think this is one of the best, if not the best game out there.
Great graphics, huge environments, great atmosphere and they really nail it on how the space marine would look and feel.

Most people say the game is repetitive, yes, but at the middle of the game you have some surprises and changes, so it's not so bad.

If you are new on the Warhammer 40k world and want to know more about the lore and how Space Marine are, or just a fan, play it. Really recommend this game, it's not perfect but is very fun!

FOR THE EMPEROR!

Great for 40k Die Hards. Def a new prospective! However, if you buy this on sale and decide to go all out with all the DLCs , DON'T, they are multiplayer only. Basically you pay double for half the product because nobody plays multiplayer as there are no lobbies. Purchase base game only, no bells and whistles and please get it on sale for 7 bucks. 

Only in Death does Duty End.

I'm a fan of Warhammer 40,000, and particularly the Space Marines, so I was looking forward to playing this game when I received it.

However, good though it is... and it is good.... its just not brilliant.

The issue comes down to repetition and a general feeling of 'emptiness'.

If you wish to see 'better' games, please see my other game reviews on Steam.

[h1] TL;DR [/h1]

The campaign story and game play feels great. 
Wait for a sale. 
Takes about 6.5 - 7.5 hours to complete the campaign. 

[h1] Opinion [/h1]

Playing the first level of the campaign, I had this feeling that I was playing Halo: Combat Evolved, where you play as a super soldier and the hordes of enemies are nothing, but nuisance. You are unstoppable; the weapons are suitable and fair.

One thing that I enjoyed in this game were the audio logs, I tried to find most of them and to immerse myself about the lore and story more. Although the audio logs aren't necessary to the core story, some of the logs help fill the backstory, commentaries from citizens, and answer questions like [spoiler] why wasn't the planet prepared for the ork invasion. [/spoiler] 

One negative aspect in the campaign is that the story and enemies are fine until you get near to the end or when you encounter [spoiler] Chaos forces [/spoiler]. 

[strike] It is unfortunate that we will not be able to get a sequel for this awesome game or knowing more about the fate of [spoiler] Captain Titus [/spoiler]. [/strike]

I recommend playing this game with a controller.
